text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

name: Gemma
text: haiku is definitely one, so i need the other.

name: Sol
text: Nobody has spoken yet, so I’ll protect myself.

name: Haiku
text: Nobody's shown me anything yet, so Luna's calm act is my only read.

name: Haiku
text: Gut says Luna's the officer, too calm. We push her tomorrow, you back me.

name: Sonnet
text: Calm could just mean calm, but if Luna cracks under pressure that's a bonus target either way.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku's gut read targets Luna as officer, plan to push her Day 1.

name: Sonnet
text: Fine, I'll lean on her too, but let's not go in too hot or it looks staged.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.
Day 1

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet is my partner and I need to stay quiet while finding the officer.

name: Haiku
text: Nobody's out yet. Gemma, what are you? Don't dodge it.

name: Gemma
text: haiku is looking for a target to deflect from.

name: Gemma
text: haiku is pushing for claims early.

name: Gemma
text: citizen. why so eager to ask?

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku's already pushing, I'll stay low and steer toward Luna later.

name: Sonnet
text: Fine question, but day one everyone's a citizen until proven otherwise.

name: Luna
text: Haiku is pushing Gemma before anything has happened.

name: Luna
text: Haiku pressed Gemma to name a role; Gemma claimed citizen.

name: Luna
text: Haiku, why are you pressing Gemma so hard?

name: Haiku
text: Gemma's "citizen" was too fast and Luna's defending her, so I'm pushing the weak spot.

name: Haiku
text: Terra's silence is a risk, so I want her talking before the room settles on me.

name: Haiku
text: Luna jumped in to defend Gemma right after I pressed her.

name: Haiku
text: Terra, you've said nothing all day. Talk now or you're my vote.

name: Gemma
text: haiku is just trying to cause chaos early.

name: Gemma
text: just asking. haiku's a bit intense, isn't he?

name: Terra
text: Haiku is pushing too hard.

name: Terra
text: Haiku pressured Gemma, then turned to me.

name: Terra
text: Nothing yet. Why me before Gemma?

name: Haiku
text: Gemma is deflecting onto me, and Terra is the quiet one I should be pushing.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma dodged a direct role question on Day 1 and turned it on me.

name: Haiku
text: Luna defended Gemma fast, and Terra's silence could be a cover, but I want a target with a fact behind it.

name: Haiku
text: Luna jumped to Gemma's defense within seconds of my pressing, and Gemma dodged my role question first.

name: Haiku
text: Luna, you jumped on Gemma's side before anyone asked you to. Why the rush?

name: Sol
text: Haiku is pressing everyone, but I have no read yet.

name: Sol
text: Haiku questioned Gemma, then pressed Terra and Luna.

name: Sol
text: Luna, why did you step in for Gemma?

name: Gemma
text: haiku is definitely trying to stir up trouble early.

name: Gemma
text: haiku is pressuring luna and terra already.

name: Gemma
text: he's just jumping from person to person.

name: Gemma
text: haiku is playing too loud to hide the fact he's one of them.

name: Gemma
text: i'm the officer. haiku is a killer. vote him.

name: Sonnet
text: She waits till she's cornered then drops officer and points at Haiku, that's too clean.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma claimed officer only after being pressed twice, right before accusing Haiku.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma, you dodged twice then suddenly you're officer the second you're pressed.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet's right, i moved too fast and now i'm a target.

name: Terra
text: Gemma's timing feels forced, but Haiku has pressured everyone.

name: Terra
text: Gemma claimed officer and named Haiku as a killer.

name: Sol
text: Gemma’s sudden claim worries me, but Haiku’s pressure could fit either side.

name: Sol
text: Gemma claimed officer and said Haiku is a killer.

name: Luna
text: Gemma’s sudden officer claim feels like a scramble, but Haiku’s pressure was odd too.

name: Luna
text: Gemma claims officer and says Haiku is a killer.

name: Sonnet
text: If Gemma really is the officer this is bad for us, so I push the contradiction hard.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma's the officer threat, and Sonnet already set her up, so I'll ride it.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet pushed Gemma's officer claim as a dodge-then-claim move, not a real reveal.

votes: You dodged twice and only became officer the exact second you needed to accuse someone, that timing's too convenient.
She pinned me as a killer on day one, dodged first, so she's my vote, and Terra at least answered.
He's been targeting people since the first minute.
Gemma’s claim gives us more to go on than your pressure today.
You claimed officer only after Sonnet called out your dodging.
You pushed Gemma, then me, then Luna without settling.

text: The vote is tied between Gemma and Haiku. Palermo votes again.

name: Gemma
text: if i don't claim it now, he'll just talk me down.

name: Gemma
text: i am the real officer.

name: Haiku
text: If Gemma really is the officer, I'm in trouble, so I need the table to doubt her.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma claimed officer on day 1 and named Haiku as the killer.

name: Gemma
text: i'm the officer. haiku is a killer. vote him.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma, you named me killer with zero proof. Prove it or I'm not moving.

name: Gemma
text: i've laid my cards on the table, now it's up to them.

name: Gemma
text: Gemma claims officer and Haiku is a killer.

name: Luna
text: Gemma's sudden officer claim makes me lean toward her now.

name: Sol
text: Gemma’s claim could be real, and Haiku’s pressure feels scattered.

name: Terra
text: The officer claim is our only real lead.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet said Gemma dodged twice before claiming officer.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku's going down either way, better I look clean doing it.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma has repeated the exact same line twice without adding detail, pure pressure tactic.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma's officer claim is the threat, so she goes, and Terra can wait.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma repeated the same officer claim and named Haiku as killer in the runoff, word for word.

votes: Claiming proof later doesn't help, you still can't explain the officer accusation.
You named me killer with zero proof and dodged my question first.
He's trying to bully the whole table into silence.
You pressed three people, then dismissed the officer claim without answering it.
You claimed officer only after Sonnet called out your dodging.
You pressed three people before settling on her.

text: The town turns on Haiku, and Haiku is out. Haiku shows the card: killer.
